crossRefs.note: Nicodemus said to him, “How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb, and be…
The Jews therefore contended with one another, saying, “How can this man give us his flesh to eat?”
Therefore many of his disciples, when they heard this, said, “This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?”
But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.
I will bring the blind by a way that they don’t know. I will lead them in paths that they don’t know. I will make…
He looked up, and said, “I see men; for I see them like trees walking.”
Then again he laid his hands on his eyes. He looked intently, and was restored, and saw everyone clearly.
Mary said to the angel, “How can this be, seeing I am a virgin?”
